name: faq
description: FAQ accordion: a centred heading over ruled question rows that open in place. Live: the `.ap-faq` section on every vertical, hub and solution page.

eyebrow.description: Small label above the heading (default variant, and the hub variant in the stack layout).

items.description: Questions. Each: q (question) and a (answer). Line breaks in the answer are kept.

open_first.description: Start with the first question open.

schema.description: Also output FAQPage structured data for these questions. Use on one FAQ per page.

variant.description: vertical: the product pages' FAQ (inset rows, two-state chevron, top rules only, their own type scale). hub: the industry hubs' FAQ (live #ap-gov-faq, plus/minus rows). eduhub: the Education hub's FAQ (live #ap-eduhub-faq).

title_gap_m.description: Vertical variant: the same space at 767px and below, where it differs (live Fire and Police pad the heading 40px on phones). -1 keeps title_gap.

title_gap.description: Vertical variant: space between the heading and the first question, in px (live: 82 on most product pages, 54 on Fire, 28 on Police).

tone.description: Section background: the grey-to-white gradient, plain white (live Higher Education and Local Government), or fade (white at the top fading to light grey at the bottom, Figma Integrations hub FAQ). The hub variant keeps its own gradient by default and takes white or fade; eduhub ignores it.

question_tone.description: Hub variant: closed questions in the heading colour (default) or in indigo (live Government).

layout.description: Hub variant: stack puts the heading centred over the questions (today's hub FAQ); split puts the heading in a left column beside the questions from 1025px wide and stacks it above them below that (Figma Integrations hub FAQ, 7310:163738).
